topics.en: The siege tactic: how settlers turned a tent into a land transfer
topics.ar: الحصار وسيلةً: كيف تحوّلت خيمة المستوطنين إلى انتقال ملكية
topics.q: Researched anatomy of the household-siege tactic that Qusra's Ras al-Ein made visible in August 2026 and that Human Rights Watch placed inside 107 emptied communities on 20 August. Trace the method rather than the incident: where it was first documented (Masafer Yatta, the Jordan Valley herding communities, Khirbet Humsa), how a tent pitched metres from a door becomes a permanent outpost, which military orders (closed military zones, Area C planning refusals, the 'special security area' designation) convert presence into legal fact, and what the record shows about army conduct at the scene. Attribute every element to OCHA, B'Tselem, Yesh Din, Amnesty, HRW or the named court file with its date; carry the army's own explanations and the internal Israeli criticism (the Ynet and Channel 12 warnings of August 2026) beside them. Separate what is documented from what residents report and cannot yet prove.

topics.en: The clearance-revenue ledger: who takes what before Ramallah is paid
topics.ar: دفتر أموال المقاصة.. من يقتطع ماذا قبل أن تُدفع لرام الله
topics.q: Researched explainer of the Palestinian Authority's clearance-revenue arithmetic, the single number that decides whether salaries are paid: what Israel collects on the PA's behalf under the Paris Protocol, the published deduction lines (electricity, water, health referrals, the prisoner-payments deduction under the 2018 law, Israeli court judgments enforced against the PA), the handling-fee dispute, the withheld balances now held in escrow and the Norwegian mechanism's role. Show the flow with a dated table sourced to the PA finance ministry, the Bank of Israel, the IMF and World Bank reports; explain why the same monthly transfer sits at the centre of the PA litigation docket and of every European conditionality debate. No advice, no forecasts — arithmetic and attribution.

topics.en: The kingmaker no bloc will seat: the Arab lists' election arithmetic
topics.ar: صانع الملوك الذي لا يقبله أحد.. حساب القوائم العربية في الانتخابات
topics.q: Researched pre-election study of the seat arithmetic facing Palestinian citizens of Israel before the 27 October Knesset vote: the Hadash-Ta'al-Balad joint slate and Ra'am running apart, the threshold risk each faces alone, turnout in Arab towns across the last five elections with the source for each figure, and the documented positions of Netanyahu, Eisenkot, Bennett-Lapid, Golan and Liberman on sitting with or relying on the Arab lists. Set out, bloc by bloc and attributed to the named pollster, which coalitions are arithmetically possible without them and which are not. Frame the Palestinian stakes plainly — annexation, Gaza policy, the crime-wave enforcement file — without predicting a result.

topics.en: Hebrew reporters trace how outposts empty Palestinian villages
topics.ar: صحافيون عبريون يتابعون كيف تُفرغ المعازل قرى فلسطينية
topics.q: Israel's own press has now documented the village-blockade method — Oded Shalom's Ynet investigation of 24 August, Elisha Ben Kimon's reporting on commanders losing control, Haaretz's Amira Hass and Hagar Shezaf, and the Yesh Din and Kerem Navot data they rely on. Report the Hebrew-language record as a body of evidence: who published what and when, which findings the army has answered and which it has not, and where the accounts of Palestinian residents differ from the Israeli reporting. Attribute every finding to its author, outlet and date; carry the army's statements beside them; keep house language for the occupied West Bank and name every village and outpost.

topics.en: Israeli commentators debate the Arab vote they will not seat
topics.ar: معلقون إسرائيليون يتناقشون في صوت عربي لا يجلسونه
topics.q: Read the Hebrew commentariat on the Arab lists as an election variable — Maariv's Aviv Bushinsky and Avi Mimran on why Netanyahu benefits from Arab votes falling under the threshold, Amit Segal's coalition arithmetic, Ynet's and Haaretz's columnists on relying on Arab MKs from outside a coalition — and set it against what the Arab lists' own leaders say. Attribute every argument to its named author and outlet with the date, name the pollster behind every number, and report honestly which positions have changed since the last election. The Palestinian stake is the point: what each configuration means for the crime-wave enforcement file, Naqab demolitions and annexation.

topics.en: A practical guide to American visas for Palestinian document holders
topics.ar: دليل عملي للتأشيرات الأميركية لحاملي الوثائق الفلسطينية
topics.q: A standing reader service in the form of the scholarship guide, not a news story — the 24 August ruling itself is already covered in `visa-ruling-palestinian-families-2026-08-24`. Map route by route what an American visa now requires of a Palestinian: which categories the proclamation covering Palestinian Authority travel documents bars and which it leaves open; what Judge Jeannette Vargas's ruling in the Southern District of New York left standing; where a Gaza resident with no functioning consular route actually applies; and the position of students holding admission letters, patients with medical referrals and families seeking reunification. Attribute every restriction to the specific proclamation, federal register notice or ruling with its date, name the immigration lawyers and organisations tracking the cases, and phrase every practical step as verify-at-source. Set it beside the Israeli visa-waiver arrangement so readers can see the asymmetry precisely, and keep it current as the litigation moves.

topics.en: FIFA pledged $67.5 million to Palestinian football and delivery lags
topics.ar: فيفا وعد الكرة الفلسطينية بـ67.5 مليون دولار والتنفيذ متأخر
topics.q: A delivery audit in the charter's constructive-framing register, not a cynicism piece. FIFA announced $67.5 million for Palestinian football in February 2026; the Palestinian Football Association counts 265 sporting facilities damaged or destroyed and more than a thousand members of the sporting community killed. Establish precisely what has been disbursed, to whom, under which FIFA programme, and what physical work it has paid for — pitches relaid, federation salaries, equipment, youth academies — separating promised, funded, underway and completed. Attribute every figure to FIFA, the AFC or the PFA with its date, name the officials who gave it, and carry FIFA's own account of any delay beside the PFA's. Close on the next practical stage rather than a verdict.

topics.en: The Palestinian women's national team plays a season without a home
topics.ar: منتخب فلسطين للسيدات يلعب موسمًا بلا أرض
topics.q: A celebratory feature on the Palestinian women's national football team, written in the register the features order requires. Where the squad trains, how a camp is assembled when West Bank players cannot reach Gaza players and diaspora call-ups need visas, who the coach is and what she or he asks of the group, the AFC and FIFA calendar the team is aiming at, and the individual players' journeys — Chile, Jordan, the United States, the West Bank clubs. Name every player, coach and official on first reference with the club she plays for. The closure is context told from the players' side, never framed as a shortfall in their commitment.

topics.en: Gaza's midwives carry the birth load a ruined hospital system left
topics.ar: قابلات غزة يحملن ولادات تركها نظام صحي مدمَّر
topics.q: Her Story rules bind: the midwives and the mothers are the subject, their words lead, our summary follows. Establish how many births Gaza records a month now, how many maternity beds and functioning delivery rooms remain, and how many midwives are still working — every count attributed to UNFPA, the WHO or the health ministry with its date. Then report the practice: home births, caesarean capacity, postnatal follow-up, anaemia and the supply lines for basic obstetric drugs. Consent and safety first on every account; no grief as raw material. Close on what the midwives themselves say the next practical stage is.

topics.en: Palestinian women in Israel are killed and the files stay open
topics.ar: نساء فلسطينيات في الداخل يُقتلن وملفاتهن تبقى مفتوحة
topics.q: Her Story and the pal48 file together. Establish the count of Palestinian women citizens of Israel killed in gender-based and criminal violence this year and last, attributed to the Abraham Initiatives, Na'amat, the Women Against Violence association in Nazareth or the named outlet, with the arrest and indictment rate stated beside it. Report what the women's organisations inside the community — Women Against Violence, Kayan, the shelters — actually provide and what they say they need. Report the issue, never the individual: no survivor named without explicit consent, no account published in a form that could identify her against her wishes.

topics.en: Sanctions compliance decides which donations ever reach Palestinian clinics
topics.ar: أنظمة الامتثال تقرر أي تبرع يصل إلى عيادات فلسطينية
topics.q: Follow the money route, not the politics. Establish how a donation raised abroad actually reaches a clinic, school or charity in Gaza or the West Bank — the correspondent banks, the payment processors, the crowdfunding platforms, the Palestinian Monetary Authority's channels — and at which step transfers are delayed or refused. Attribute every count and rule to the named institution and date: OFAC designations and general licences, the material-support statute at 18 U.S.C. 2339B, Israeli correspondent-banking indemnities, and the guidance banks say they follow. Ask the Palestinian charities and the diaspora fundraisers what they were told when an account closed, and carry the banks' or regulators' answer where one exists. Distinguish what is legally prohibited from what compliance departments refuse out of caution — that gap is the story. Constructive framing: name the workarounds that function and the practical fix the institutions themselves propose.

topics.en: Gaza's teachers plan lessons for the days the network dies
topics.ar: معلمون في غزة يخططون لدروس تصمد حين تنقطع الشبكة
topics.q: Peg to the 2026/27 school year opening in Gaza on 19 September and to UNICEF's finding that most teaching happens in tents. Report what teachers and learning-space coordinators actually do when connectivity drops for hours or days: offline lesson packs, SD-card distribution, radio, and mesh messaging between coordinators. Test the mesh claim honestly — what bitchat's current release does and does not do over distance, in dense camp blocks, on the battery a teacher has; carry documented deployments elsewhere. Every piece carries the official-download-only guidance (App Store 'bitchat mesh', id 6748219622, Permissionless Technology; the permissionlesstech GitHub APK for Android; Google Play hosts impostors). No investment advice; the ecash/payments angle stays with the Financial Freedom desk.

topics.en: Mesh messaging spreads where governments switch the internet off
topics.ar: الرسائل المتشابكة تنتشر حيث تُطفئ الحكومات الإنترنت
topics.q: The worldwide adoption report the charter's bitchat watch has queued. Establish where mesh messaging has actually been used at scale in the last two years — protest shutdowns, disaster blackouts, border regions — with each deployment attributed to a named report, outlet or research group and dated, and with download and active-user figures stated as claims where the publisher is the app's own team. Then the Palestinian angle in full: Gaza's documented blackout days, the West Bank's cellular restrictions, and what a mesh network can and cannot carry when a hospital needs a referral out. Say plainly what remains unverified. Official-download-only guidance in every piece.

topics.en: Who pays the hospital bill when Gaza's patients are treated abroad
topics.ar: من يدفع فاتورة مرضى غزة حين يُعالَجون خارج القطاع؟
topics.q: Follow the money behind medical evacuation, not the queue — the queue is already covered by arab-medical-corridors-delivery-audit. Establish who actually settles the bill for a Gaza patient treated in Egypt, Jordan, the UAE or Turkey: the Palestinian Ministry of Health's outside-referral budget, the host state, WHO, a Gulf donor, or the family. Attribute every figure to the named ministry, agency or hospital system and date it. Then the banking layer that makes this a live August 2026 story: the referral budget moves in shekels through Palestinian banks whose Israeli correspondent lines close on 1 September (Israel Discount Bank) and 1 October (Bank Hapoalim), and cross-border settlement runs on dollar correspondent accounts of the kind Treasury's FinCEN action against Banque Misr's UAE branches on 28 August showed can be withdrawn at thirty days' notice. Ask each payer plainly what happens to a referral already approved if the transfer route closes, and report non-answers as non-answers. Charter framing: separate what is promised, funded, disbursed and still owed, and credit the corridors that have delivered.

topics.en: Gaza's filmmakers rebuild a cinema culture with no cinemas left
topics.ar: سينمائيو غزة يعيدون بناء ثقافة سينمائية بلا صالات
topics.q: With two Palestinian films at Venice in September 2026, ask what the production base behind them actually is. Establish, attributed and dated: how many working film-production entities remain in Gaza and the West Bank, where Palestinian directors now edit and finish (Amman, Cairo, Ramallah, Europe), which funds carry them — the Palestinian Ministry of Culture, AFAC, the Doha Film Institute, Red Sea, European co-production funds — and what each has committed and disbursed. Name the screening spaces that survive and the ones destroyed, with the source for each. Celebratory register per the features order: this is an account of a craft continuing, not an inventory of loss. Ask filmmakers directly what a Palestinian film needs that money cannot supply.

topics.en: Palestinian museums decide what to collect while the war continues
topics.ar: المتاحف الفلسطينية تقرر ماذا تقتني والحرب مستمرة
topics.q: The acquisition and conservation question, reported through named institutions: the Palestinian Museum at Birzeit, the Yasser Arafat Museum, Dar al-Kalima, the Islamic Museum in Jerusalem and the diaspora collections. What are they buying, borrowing and refusing now; how do they conserve works when materials cross checkpoints; what happened to collections held in Gaza. Every holding figure attributed to the institution and dated. Peg to the death of Sliman Mansour in August 2026 and the question his estate raises for every Palestinian collection: who holds the canon, and where. Constructive framing — credit delivered conservation work precisely.

topics.en: Palestine names the athletes it can actually send to Nagoya
topics.ar: فلسطين تسمّي الرياضيين الذين تستطيع إرسالهم إلى ناغويا
topics.q: Written when the Asian Games delegation list publishes (Games open at Nagoya on 19 September 2026). Establish the delegation's composition against Hangzhou's (70 athletes, 15 sports, 62 men and 8 women), name every athlete and discipline, and report precisely who could not travel and why — permits, closed crossings, destroyed facilities, funding. Attribute counts to the Palestine Olympic Committee and the PFA and date them. Celebratory register for the athletes who go; the obstacles are reported as facts around them, never as the story about them.

topics.en: Palestinian women footballers restart a league across a closed map
topics.ar: لاعبات فلسطين يستأنفن دوريهنّ فوق خريطة مغلقة
topics.q: The women's game as an institutional story: which clubs still field women's teams in the West Bank, Gaza and among Palestinian citizens of Israel, what the Palestinian Football Association's women's department has funded and delivered, and how a fixture list survives 900-plus movement obstacles. Carry the national team's record precisely — the 2025 WAFF runners-up finish, the Asian Cup qualifying results, the FIFA ranking with its date — attributed. Name the coaches and captains and let players describe the training week. Celebratory register per the features order.

topics.en: Latin America's Palestinian federations decide what solidarity buys
topics.ar: اتحادات فلسطينيي أميركا اللاتينية تقرر ماذا يشتري التضامن
topics.q: Follow the institutions, not the ancestry: the Federación Palestina de Chile, the Honduran and Salvadoran Palestinian clubs and chambers of commerce, the Brazilian and Argentine federations. What each has actually raised and delivered for Gaza and the West Bank since October 2023 — sums, recipients, dates, attributed to the federation or the receiving body — and what political weight they carry with their governments. Set it against the state-level record (Honduras and Bolivia leaving the Hague Group in March 2026; Chile's and Colombia's positions). Constructive framing: credit delivered work precisely, distinguish pledged from disbursed.

topics.en: Gulf employers hold the papers that decide a Palestinian's residency
topics.ar: أرباب العمل في الخليج يمسكون أوراق إقامة الفلسطيني
topics.q: The largest working Palestinian diaspora is in the Gulf and it is the least reported. Establish, country by country and attributed to the named authority: which travel documents Gulf states accept from Palestinians (PA passport, Egyptian travel document, Jordanian temporary passport, Lebanese refugee document), what each permits, how residency renewal works when the holder cannot return to the issuing authority, and what happens to a family when the sponsor dies or the job ends. Carry remittance figures from the World Bank or PMA with dates. Report the issue, never the individual; anonymise workers who ask for it.

topics.en: West Bank firefighters reach settler arson fires without water
topics.ar: إطفائيو الضفة يصلون إلى حرائق المستوطنين بلا ماء
topics.q: A trade profile of the civil defence crews, in the same register as the ambulance-crews report of 30 August 2026. How a West Bank fire station plans a run when hydrants are dry, tankers must refill in Area A, and the fire is in Area C behind a gate. Carry the arson record attributed and dated — settlers behind roughly 89 per cent of fires on Palestinian property per the figure circulating in the Palestinian wire in August 2026, verified at writing against the originating body — and the olive-grove burn season ahead. Let the crews describe the craft: route memory, water arithmetic, the decision to let a field go to save a house. Never grief as raw material.

topics.en: Gaza's water engineers keep wells running on improvised parts
topics.ar: مهندسو المياه في غزة يبقون الآبار تعمل بقطع مرتجلة
topics.q: The people who keep Gaza's water system alive as a trade, not as a humanitarian statistic: the municipal and Coastal Municipalities Water Utility engineers and technicians who repair pumps, splice lines and improvise parts held on dual-use lists. How many remain working, attributed to the utility or OCHA and dated; what a repair actually involves; where the spare parts come from. Pair with the desalination and pipeline figures, each attributed. Celebratory register for the craft; the siege is the condition, not the subject.

topics.en: American courts test how far Washington can punish Palestine speech
topics.ar: محاكم أميركية تختبر حدود معاقبة واشنطن للكلام عن فلسطين
topics.q: Track the litigation line the American press is now reporting as a running story: Judge Noel Wise's ruling of 28 August 2026 for The Stanford Daily, the 2025 Boston federal decision it builds on, the visa-revocation cases, and the university disciplinary record. Attribute every holding to the named judge, court and date, and keep the two distinct — what a court has enjoined versus what an administration has said it will keep doing. Report the government's argument fairly and carry the Justice Department's response or its absence. Frame for Palestinian readers: what a foreign student in the United States can now say.

topics.en: Washington's think tanks publish rival plans for governing Gaza
topics.ar: مراكز الأبحاث الأميركية تنشر خططًا متنافسة لحكم غزة
topics.q: Read the day-after literature as the uspress desk reads a newspaper: the Board of Peace and stabilisation-force papers from MEI, Carnegie, Brookings, WINEP, the Quincy Institute, CSIS and the Arab Center DC. Label each institution's lean plainly and attribute every proposal to its named author. Set the papers against the record — the International Stabilisation Force's troop commitments and the $206m in US funding notified to Congress in August 2026, each attributed and dated. The test throughout: which plans give Palestinians a decision, which give them a recipient's role, and which do not mention Palestinian consent at all.

topics.en: The Hormuz war premium reaches Palestinian fuel pumps and generators
topics.ar: علاوة حرب هرمز تصل إلى محطات الوقود والمولدات الفلسطينية
topics.q: Trace the price line from the contested Strait of Hormuz to a household bill in Gaza and the West Bank. Crude traded near $90 a barrel at the Iran war's six-month mark, CSIS panellists said on 24 August 2026, with global spare capacity and OPEC's regulating role both gone. Palestinian fuel arrives through Israeli suppliers at Israeli-set prices, so establish what the Palestinian Authority's petroleum authority and the Gaza generator markets actually paid month by month since February 2026, each figure attributed and dated. Report what a shekel of that increase does to a bakery, a dialysis unit's generator and a water pump — and state plainly which part of the rise is the war premium and which is the closure.

topics.en: Jordan's medical corridor for Gaza patients runs through a war zone
topics.ar: الممر الطبي الأردني لمرضى غزة يمر اليوم في ساحة حرب
topics.q: Establish what the Jordanian corridor actually carries for Palestinian patients and what the Iran war does to it. Jordan runs field hospitals in Gaza and receives wounded and chronically ill Palestinians for treatment in Amman, while the Jordan Hashemite Charity Organisation and the Jordanian army sent their 190th land relief convoy to Gaza on 15 August 2026 with forty-three trucks. Since 31 August 2026 Iranian ballistic missiles have entered Jordanian airspace — the armed forces said they intercepted eight that morning — and Jordan hosts roughly 4,000 American defence personnel who make it a target. Count, with every figure attributed to the named Jordanian ministry, WHO office or UN logistics cluster report and dated: how many Gaza patients and companions moved through Jordan in 2026, how many are waiting, how many medical flights or convoys were delayed or cancelled when airspace closed during exchanges of fire, and what Jordanian hospitals say they need to keep the corridor open. Carry the Jordanian government's own account of the programme and credit delivered work precisely, separating what is promised, funded, underway and still needed.

topics.en: Arab states booked a Gaza reconstruction conference; the money decides
topics.ar: الدول العربية حجزت مؤتمرًا لإعمار غزة.. والمال هو الحكم
topics.q: Track the Arab-led Gaza reconstruction track: the Egyptian-hosted conference process and its Arab League endorsement, the Saudi, Emirati, Qatari and Kuwaiti commitments announced against sums actually transferred to the World Bank-administered fund or to named implementing agencies, the sequencing dispute over who governs the Strip before rubble moves, and the Arab technical teams already working. Every pledge with its date, its currency and its status — promised, funded, underway, completed — attributed to the named ministry or fund. Constructive framing per the charter: credit delivered work precisely and name what is still needed as the next practical stage.

topics.en: Arab education ministries lend teachers to Gaza's ruined school year
topics.ar: وزارات تعليم عربية تُعير معلمين لعام غزة الدراسي المدمَّر
topics.q: Evergreen keeper topic — recyclable each term. What Arab education ministries, universities and unions are doing for Gaza's school year: seconded and volunteer teachers, remote-teaching platforms staffed from Cairo, Amman and the Gulf, printed curriculum shipments through El-Arish, teacher-training places offered to Gaza staff, and Arab funding of the temporary learning spaces UNICEF counts. Numbers attributed to the named ministry, university or UN agency with dates; separate what is running today from what is announced. Pair with the education-under-fire and school-year files.

topics.en: The FBI and Shin Bet share a channel; Palestinians never see it
topics.ar: قناة تجمع المباحث الفدرالية والشاباك.. والفلسطينيون لا يرونها
topics.q: Establish, from the documentary record only, what American and Israeli internal security services formally share and what that means for Palestinians on both sides of the Atlantic. The FBI director Kash Patel met the Shin Bet director general David Zini at bureau headquarters on 1 September 2026 and said the agenda covered counterterrorism, terrorist-financing networks, intelligence sharing and counter-drone training; Israeli Channel 13 first reported the trip and neither government announced it. Build the record around what is public and citable: the FBI legal attache office in Tel Aviv and its stated mandate, US-Israel law enforcement and information-sharing agreements and their published texts, congressional testimony and inspector-general or GAO reports on foreign liaison relationships, and the documented cases in which US persons of Palestinian origin were questioned or watchlisted after foreign-supplied information. Set beside it what the Shin Bet does in the occupied West Bank, where it interrogates detainees and recommends administrative detention orders, with counts attributed to Addameer, HaMoked or B'Tselem and dated. Every claim tied to a named document, filing or official; state plainly what is not disclosed rather than inferring it, carry the FBI's and the Israeli government's own descriptions of the relationship, and report the issue and the system, never an individual.
